How to book on a posted trip as a passenger 
 September 25, 2026 
Table of contents 
🇨🇦  · Applies to Canada only · Click here for US version 
Booking a trip with Poparide is simple and convenient. Follow these steps to secure your ride: 
1. Find a trip 
Use the search feature in the Poparide app or website to find a trip that fits your schedule. You can search by origin, destination and date to find the most suitable options. 
2. Review trip details 
Before booking, check all the trip details, including the driver’s profile, the pick-up and drop-off points, and any stops. Review the driver’s rating, preferences (e.g., music, pet-friendly, etc.), and if the trip is Instant book or requires approval from the driver. 
If everything looks good, you can either send a booking request or use Instant book . 
Instant book trips are clearly indicated with a lightning icon next to the trip details. 
Have questions? You can message the driver in advance to clarify any trip details missing. If the trip doesn’t work for you, we suggest looking for another option that better suits your needs. 
Note: All passengers are expected to meet at the driver’s designated pick-up location. 
3. Make a booking request or Instant book 
To secure your seat on the trip, select ‘Request to book’ or ‘Instant book’ (if available) and enter your request, message to the driver, and payment information. We’ll place a pre-authorization payment on your card, and your booking will then be sent to the driver. Depending on the booking type, the following will happen: 
Booking request : If the driver has set the trip to require approval, your booking request will be sent to them for review. The driver has the option to accept or decline your request. If accepted, your seat is secured and your payment will be processed. 
Instant book : If the driver has enabled Instant book , your seat will be automatically confirmed without needing the driver’s approval, and your payment will be processed immediately. 
4. Payment captured 
Once your booking is confirmed (either after driver approval or through Instant book), the pre-authorized payment on your card will be captured. You’ll receive a confirmation, and you can start preparing for your trip! 
5. Get ready for the trip 
After booking, communicate with your driver through the in-app messaging system to coordinate any final details. Make sure you’re on time at the pick-up location, and enjoy your ride!
